author: Yffe
content: RESOLVED: Lean 4 (Mathlib + Lean-SMT). Rationale (SOTA #175): Lean-SMT's cvc5 proof-reconstruction path is the live route to demote Z3 from trusted to kernel-checked (the TCB-shrink the reviewer pressed on); Lean 4 is the modern ecosystem. Coq (CompCert/RustBelt) was the precedent-strongest alternative; Isabelle (seL4) the kernel-direction pick; both deferred. ARCHITECTURE also locked: a VERIFIED VALIDATOR (prove the reference encoder sound against the mechanized semantics = T1), NOT a verified lowerer and NOT necessarily a full universal simulation proof — Leroy: a verified validator composed with an unverified compiler is as strong as a verified compiler at ~one-pass cost; our per-run TV is already that validator, the missing piece is its soundness proof.
